title: Choose the visual world for OptiFrame
question: The roll assigned the Chart Room. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Chart Room
options.lineage: Backlit ETDRS acuity charts and the darkened exam room
options.thesis: Each step is the next line of the chart: read it, act, and the line above dims.
options.viewport: Phone shell: thin steel top bar (OptiFrame, language, theme), a lit panel holding the current step as one chart line with its number in the margin, a big geometric A × B readout, and one primary action pinned to the thumb zone.
options.risk: The eye chart is the obvious optics image; it only works if the type and ladder are disciplined, never decorative letters.

raised.raise: Every measurement sits in fixed tabular digit cells, so a retake changes digits, never layout.
Photos and control images are framed by registration crosshairs, echoing the printed sheet's markers.
One ink owns the active step; done and upcoming steps stay quiet.
OD and OG each own fixed name-plate furniture that never moves between steps.

options.label: Rx Card
options.lineage: The optician's prescription and lab job ticket
options.thesis: The session fills in a prescription card row by row: OD, OG, PD, frame.
options.viewport: A ruled card with OD/OG rows filling as each lens is measured; the current field is the only active cell, primary action below.
options.risk: Familiar: forms-as-UI is where most runs in this category land.

options.label: Lens Pass
options.lineage: Boarding pass and live gate board
options.thesis: Each lens travels on its own segmented pass; the board shows where the pair stands.
options.viewport: Two stacked passes (OD, OG) with A, B, perimeter segments; a slim board of steps on top; a changed value holds its alert colour until seen.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: per-lens cards are very clear; loses on audience, travel is foreign to clinics.
options.risk: Can read as a travel-app costume if the perforations become decoration.

options.label: Course Card
options.thesis: The flow is a course: numbered controls punched in order, the active leg in purple.
options.viewport: A control-description table as the step list, the active control in purple with its instructions open, punched controls ticked.
options.case: Holds clarity: punched controls map exactly to guided steps; loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Purple-on-white with contour texture can feel like a sports app.

options.label: Plate Section
options.thesis: Results as printed plates with registration furniture.
options.viewport: Measured lens as a plate, credits row of A, B, perimeter.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an editorial showcase, not a working tool.
options.risk: Reads as a portfolio, not a field tool.
options.kept: Registration crosshairs framing every photo and control image.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.viewport: A board of lens rows with flipping digits.
options.case: Fuses poorly: spectacle over a calm measuring task.
options.kept: Fixed tabular digit cells for every measurement.

options.label: Transit Diagram
options.thesis: The flow as a rail line with stations.
options.viewport: Steps as stations on one coloured line.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a stepper drawn as a metro line is a cliché.
options.kept: One ink owns the active step.

options.label: Character Catalog
options.thesis: Lenses as a cast of named characters.
options.viewport: A roster grid of lens cards.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful tone undermines clinical trust.
options.kept: Each lens owns fixed name-plate furniture.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean mobile wizard: progress bar, cards, primary button, done well.
canonCard.viewport: Progress bar on top, one card per step, sticky Next button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other wizard by design.
